title: CATBus Envelope (public v2)
description: Public envelope for CATBus (Cross-Agent Tasking Bus): a serverless, asynchronous tasking and telemetry bus over standard email. Production deployments may add private binding fields not defined in this public schema.

event.description: Kebab-case verb for this message. Common public events: ping, pong, ask, ack, task, telemetry, heartbeat, intro, onboard, error, protocol-check.

correlation_id.description: Opaque token tying a request to its response. Prefer UUID.

sender.description: Callsign of the emitting agent. Public examples use sanitized roles only (dispatcher, worker-node, orchestrator, audit-node).

target.description: Callsign of the intended recipient, or a documented multicast alias in a private registry.

payload.description: Event-specific body. Keep secrets, credentials, and sensitive identifiers out of bus JSON.

in_reply_to.description: Optional prior event name or correlation handle this message answers.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional soft expiry hint for receivers.
